lines.en: and the abundance of wind and thunder and lightning, and death among the soldiers. And if Jupiter is elevated, the strength of the condition of rulers

lines.text: و ادویه باشد و ظفر بر دشمن و جستن بادها (و اگر در اسد بود) دولت و اقبال کتاب و دبیران
lines.en: and medicines, and victory over the enemy, and the blowing of winds. (And if it is in Leo) the wealth and good fortune of writers and scribes,

lines.text: و کثرت فوائد ندما و قتل بزرگی در جبال و ظهور غیوم و موت یکی از حکام اطراف بابل
lines.en: and the abundance of benefits for companions, and the killing of a great man in the mountains, and the appearance of clouds, and the death of one of the rulers of the regions of Babylon,

summary.headline: Mercury–Jupiter Conjunction Forecasts
summary.text: Astrological forecasts for the conjunction of Mercury and Jupiter in Aries, Leo, Sagittarius, and the earthy triplicity, covering rulers, merchants, scholars, weather, warfare, disease, trade, and regional conditions from Babylon and Arabia to Syria, India, and Khuzestan.
